new_scholarship.name: ER.GO Borsa di studio - Emilia-Romagna Regional Right-to-Study Scholarship for international students at the University of Parma
new_scholarship.program_type: Regional right-to-study scholarship (means-tested) with a linked tuition-fee exemption
new_scholarship.official_source: ER.GO - Azienda Regionale per il Diritto agli Studi Superiori dell'Emilia-Romagna, jointly with the University of Parma
new_scholarship.duration: 3 years for a bachelor's / laurea triennale at the University of Parma; the benefit itself is granted one academic year at a time and must be re-applied for annually
new_scholarship.deadline: Official wording for a.y. 2026/2027: 'Borsa di studio - inizio presentazione domanda 23/06/2026, scadenza presentazione domanda 24/08/2026 ore 16.00' (applications open 23 June 2026, closing 24 August 2026 at 16:00). ER.GO describes the deadlines of the call as mandatory and not extendable ('tassative e improrogabili').
new_scholarship.application_period: 23 June 2026 to 24 August 2026, 16:00 Italian time, for the 2026/2027 academic year. A separate University of Parma request for the personalised university contribution (domanda per contributo universitario personalizzato) remained open until 4 November 2026 at 17:00.
new_scholarship.application_method: A separate application, submitted by the student directly and exclusively online on the ER.GO Dossier Utente (personal dossier) using the benefits application form for the relevant academic year, ticking the borsa di studio benefit. It is not automatic on admission and does not depend on the university application. The application may be filed before enrolment, including by applicants still awaiting a study-visa acceptance letter, but enrolment must be finalised by the enrolment deadlines of the call for the economic condition to count. For students with income or assets abroad the foreign income documentation must additionally be uploaded in the Dossier Utente under Corrispondenza e Protocollo > Invia documentazione > Documentazione redditi esteri. Applications started at a CAF or with university credentials must be finalised with PEC or PIN by the same deadline.
new_scholarship.description: The borsa di studio is the Emilia-Romagna regional right-to-study scholarship, assigned by public competition (concorso pubblico) to students enrolled at universities in the region, including international students whose household income and assets are held abroad. It is available for first-cycle (bachelor's), single-cycle and graduate programmes and therefore funds entry into a bachelor's degree. Eligible students receive a cash sum, total exemption from university tuition fees and a refund of the regional tax, and may convert part of the scholarship into catering vouchers. For a student with foreign income, ER.GO converts the family's economic condition into the Italian ISEE system on the basis of legalised, Italian-translated income and assets documentation.
new_scholarship.best_fit: A non-EU high-school leaver from a middle- or low-income household abroad who wants a bachelor's or single-cycle degree at the University of Parma, can assemble legalised and Italian-translated foreign income documents inside the short summer window, and needs university fees waived as well as a cash contribution for living costs. It also fits applicants who can document a domicile in Parma to obtain the higher fuori sede benefit band.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to students of any nationality enrolled, or applying to enrol, at a university or higher arts and music institution in Emilia-Romagna, with no nationality, age or field-of-study restriction. Three cumulative requirements apply: an economic requirement, a merit requirement and an enrolment requirement. The economic requirement is that both the ISEE and the ISPE of the family unit fall below the thresholds published for the year (EUR 25,000.00 ISEE and EUR 50,000.00 ISPE for a.y. 2026/2027); students with income or assets abroad have their situation converted to the Italian system from legalised and Italian-translated foreign income documentation issued in the year of the application. The merit requirement is a minimum number of university credits (CFU) earned in each academic year, set out in the call's merit tables per seat of study, including a dedicated Parma table; as a first-year entrant (matricola) the applicant is assessed solely on the economic requirement and the school-leaving grade is not considered. The enrolment requirement is that enrolment is finalised by the enrolment deadlines of the call, since a career that is not active in the secretariat leaves the ranking position suspended. The application may be filed before enrolment. No English or other language test is required by the scholarship itself; the foreign income documentation must be translated into Italian.
eligibility: Enrolled, or applying to enrol, at a university or higher institute for art and music in Emilia-Romagna for the relevant academic year.
No nationality restriction: EU and non-EU applicants alike, including international students with household income and assets abroad.
Economic requirement: ISEE not exceeding EUR 25,000.00 and ISPE not exceeding EUR 50,000.00 for a.y. 2026/2027; if either value exceeds the threshold the application cannot be submitted.

Students with income and/or assets abroad must have their economic and asset situation converted to the Italian system by submitting documentation of household income for the previous year and assets as at 31 December of the previous year, issued by the competent authority in the country of origin in the year of the application, legalised or apostilled and translated into Italian.

Merit requirement: a minimum number of university credits (CFU) must be earned in each academic year, both to access and to confirm the benefit; the credit tables are published per seat of study, including a dedicated Parma table.

As a first-year entrant (matricola) the applicant is assessed solely on the economic requirement: ER.GO states that the school-leaving grade 'non e tenuto in considerazione' (is not taken into consideration).
Enrolment must be finalised by the enrolment deadlines set out in the call, otherwise eligibility for the benefit is lost.
The application may be submitted before enrolment, including by applicants still awaiting a study-visa acceptance letter.
New documentation must be submitted for every academic year applied for, even where the household situation has not changed.
No age limit, no gender restriction, no field-of-study restriction and no nominating agency are published.
Domicile must be correctly documented where the fuori sede (non-resident student) status is claimed, because the amount depends on that status.
ER.GO warns applicants not to use agencies or intermediaries, which charge for the service and can cause errors, and states that it verifies the documentation submitted.
coverage: Cash scholarship for the academic year, an amount diversified by the ISEE band of the family unit and by student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede)
Total exemption from university tuition fees for students eligible for the scholarship
Refund of the regional tax paid as the first enrolment instalment (EUR 156.00 at the University of Parma for a.y. 2026/2027, being the regional tax for the right to study plus stamp duty)
Optional conversion of part of the scholarship into catering vouchers (prepagato ristorativo)
Separate, competitive access to ER.GO accommodation applied for in the same online application
benefits: A sum of money for the academic year, diversified by the ISEE band and by student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede).
Total exemption from university tuition fees (esonero totale) for students eligible for the scholarship.
Possibility of converting part of the scholarship into catering vouchers.
Eligibility to compete, in the same application, for ER.GO accommodation with its own separate deadline.

Access to ER.GO's wider benefit system, which includes part-time student collaboration positions, international mobility contributions, extraordinary contributions and disability-related benefits, each under its own call.
requirements: Submit the online benefits application on the ER.GO Dossier Utente before the deadline of the call, ticking the borsa di studio benefit.
Meet both economic thresholds for the year: ISEE up to EUR 25,000.00 and ISPE up to EUR 50,000.00 for a.y. 2026/2027.

Students with foreign income or assets: obtain, legalise or apostille and translate into Italian the documentation of household income for the previous year and assets as at 31 December of the previous year, issued by the competent authority in the year of application.
Upload the foreign income documentation in the Dossier Utente under Documentazione redditi esteri by the deadline of the call.
Finalise the online submission with PEC or PIN where the application was started at a CAF or with university credentials.
Finalise enrolment at the University of Parma by the enrolment deadlines of the call so that the career is active in the secretariat.
Earn the minimum number of credits (CFU) set for the relevant academic year, by 10 August of each academic year, to keep the benefit.
Document the domicile where the fuori sede status is claimed.

Present a foreign secondary school qualification giving access to university study in the country of issue, obtained after at least 12 years of schooling, with a CIMEA certificate of comparability, an ARDI certificate of equivalence or a Declaration of Value.
Obtain an Italian tax code (codice fiscale) in order to file the benefits application.
required_documents: Completed online benefits application on the ER.GO Dossier Utente, with the borsa di studio benefit selected
Documentation of household income for the previous year, issued by the competent authority in the country of origin, legalised or apostilled and translated into Italian
Documentation of household assets as at 31 December of the previous year, legalised or apostilled and translated into Italian
Documentation of domicile, or the autocertificazione di domicilio, where the fuori sede status is claimed
Documentation of income and assets held both in Italy and abroad, where applicable
Final secondary school qualification with CIMEA certificate of comparability, ARDI certificate of equivalence or Declaration of Value
Transcript of examinations and certificate of any university admission aptitude test, or the Foundation Year certificate, where the country's school system is shorter than 12 years
Italian translations of all academic and financial documents not already in Italian
Authenticity documentation for foreign academic qualifications: legalisation, apostille or ENIC-NARIC certificate
Copy of passport and, for non-EU students, the residence permit or its renewal receipt
University acceptance letter, where the applicant is still awaiting a study visa
Proof of finalised enrolment at the University of Parma
new_scholarship.selection_notes: Selection is by public competition with ranking lists. ER.GO publishes a call each year, indicatively from mid-June, and ranks applicants on their economic condition: the amounts of the scholarships are diversified by the ISEE band of the family unit and by the condition of student in sede, pendolare or fuori sede. No weighting formula is published and no interview, portfolio or leadership component exists. ER.GO states that there are no merit-only scholarships among the benefits it pays out, because an economic requirement always applies; for a first-year entrant the school-leaving grade is explicitly not considered and the applicant is assessed solely on the economic requirement. Being eligible in a provisional ranking means only that the requirements of the call are met; assignment is communicated through the Dossier Utente only after the pre-definitive ranking is published. The benefit is granted for one academic year and must be re-requested each year, and it is revocable with repayment if the minimum credits are not reached by 10 August.

new_scholarship.notes: Target selection: the University of Turin's dedicated international scholarship schemes (Talents 4 UniTo, UNICORE 8.0 and UniTo for Students at Risk) are all reserved for postgraduate programmes or for students with refugee or international-protection status, so none of them is a bachelor's-level award; its undergraduate offer for non-EU students is an automatic GDP-per-capita-PPP reduction of the all-inclusive contribution rather than a competitive scholarship. The University of Milan (unimi.it) returned HTTP 403 on every fetch attempt and could not be assessed. The University of Parma was therefore selected as the best-documented bachelor's-eligible international award. The awarding body of the recorded award is the regional agency ER.GO, not the university: the University of Parma's own international-students page states that 'Er.go and the University of Parma jointly administer benefits for students, including scholarship, accommodation and reduced university fees'. No substitution was required. No monetary amount is published on any reachable official page: ER.GO states that the amounts are defined by the annual competition announcement and are diversified by ISEE band and student status, and the euro tables sit in the PDF call (Sezione II Borse di studio) and in the 'Importi, pagamenti e revoche' tables, which were not parsed; funding_amount, funding_currency and funding_period are therefore null rather than estimated. The number of scholarships is likewise not published, because ER.GO allocates against regional budget through ranking lists rather than a fixed quota. The 2026/2027 deadline of 24 August 2026 at 16:00 Italian time has passed as of the verification date of 3 October 2026, so the record is marked closed and carries the next-cycle expectation that ER.GO publishes a new call indicatively from mid-June each year; the 2027/2028 dates are not yet published and the expectation is an inference from ER.GO's stated practice, not an official announcement. Two deadlines must not be conflated: the ER.GO scholarship and total-exemption deadline of 24 August 2026 at 16:00, and the University of Parma's later personalised university contribution deadline of 4 November 2026 at 17:00. ER.GO is not a white-on-transparent wordmark and the logo was probed live (HTTP 200, image/png, 4954 bytes); the host er-go.it was not already present in backend/config/official_logo_overrides.json, so no deduplication is expected. programme_detail_official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 entry; applications open 23 June 2026 and close 24 August 2026 at 16:00 Italian time; ER.GO publishes a new call each year, indicatively from mid-June, so a 2027/2028 call is expected from around mid-June 2027 with no dates yet published
programme_detail_official.deadline_central_display: 24 August 2026, 16:00 (Italian time). Official wording: 'Borsa di studio - inizio presentazione domanda 23/06/2026, scadenza presentazione domanda 24/08/2026 ore 16.00'; the same date and time applies to the 'Esonero totale per richiedenti borsa di studio'.
programme_detail_official.deadline_note: A single central deadline of 24 August 2026 at 16:00 (Italian time, CEST) applied to the 2026/2027 borsa di studio and to the linked total tuition exemption, and the deadline is published with an explicit clock time and country, so the timezone is Europe/Rome. ER.GO states the deadlines of the call are mandatory and cannot be postponed. No earlier institutional deadline exists: the University of Parma's own request for the personalised university contribution (domanda per contributo universitario personalizzato) for a.y. 2026/2027 is later, 4 November 2026 at 17:00, and the enrolment finalisation deadline for applicants with a foreign qualification is likewise later, so neither is recorded as an earlier institutional date. The central deadline has passed as of the verification date of 3 October 2026, so the cycle is closed; the next cycle's dates are not yet published and the expectation of a mid-June 2027 opening is an inference from ER.GO's stated practice of publishing a new call indicatively from mid-June each year, not an official announcement.
programme_detail_official.status_note: The 2026/2027 call opened on 23 June 2026 and closed on 24 August 2026 at 16:00, which has passed as of the verification date of 3 October 2026; the ER.GO site labels the benefit 'Scaduto il 24/08/2026 16:00' (expired 24 August 2026, 16:00). ER.GO publishes a new competition announcement every academic year, indicatively from mid-June, and states that the contents of the call may change from year to year, so a 2027/2028 call is expected around mid-June 2027 with deadlines to be confirmed on the same deadlines page.
programme_detail_official.funding_duration: One academic year at a time. The student must submit a new application for every academic year, even without prior enrolment, with newly issued foreign income documentation for each year applied for, and must reach the minimum credits by 10 August of each year to keep the benefit. A bachelor's degree at the University of Parma nominally runs three academic years.
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: ER.GO states that a student eligible for the scholarship is entitled to 'esonero totale' from the payment of university tuition fees and to the refund of the regional tax. At the University of Parma the annual personalised tuition contribution for students with income abroad ranges from EUR 0 to about EUR 2,000 depending on financial situation and area of study, and the first instalment is EUR 156.00 (regional tax for the right to study plus stamp duty), which is refunded with the regional tax. The award is not recorded as unconditionally fully funded: the cash amount is not published on any reachable official page, so the real value cannot be confirmed from the official source; the benefit is means-tested against ISEE and ISPE thresholds and is not guaranteed to all eligible students; it must be re-won each academic year and can be revoked with repayment if the minimum credits are not reached by 10 August; and undocumented domicile reduces the fuori sede band. fully_funded is therefore false.
programme_detail_official.funding_label: Means-tested regional cash borsa di studio for one academic year, amount set annually by the ER.GO competition announcement and diversified by ISEE band and by student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede), plus total university tuition-fee exemption and a regional-tax refund; the amount is not published, so no figure is recorded, and the benefit is revoked with repayment if the minimum credits are not reached by 10 August.
benefits: A sum of money for the academic year, diversified by the family unit's ISEE band and by student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede).
Total exemption from university tuition fees.
Optional conversion of part of the scholarship into catering vouchers (prepagato ristorativo).
Eligibility to compete, in the same online application, for ER.GO accommodation, which has its own deadline and its own domicile requirement.
eligibility: Enrolled, or applying to enrol, at a university or higher institute for art and music with its seat in Emilia-Romagna.
Open to applicants of any nationality, including non-EU international students with household income and assets abroad.
Economic requirement: ISEE up to EUR 25,000.00 and ISPE up to EUR 50,000.00 for a.y. 2026/2027; exceeding either threshold bars the application.
Merit requirement: a minimum number of credits (CFU) per academic year, from tables published per seat of study, with a dedicated Parma table.
Enrolment requirement: enrolment finalised by the enrolment deadlines of the call, because an inactive career suspends the ranking position.
As a first-year entrant, assessment is solely on the economic requirement: ER.GO states that the school-leaving grade 'non e tenuto in considerazione'.
No age limit, no gender restriction, no field restriction, no nominating agency and no language test for the scholarship itself.
Correct domicile documentation is required to obtain the fuori sede status that determines the amount.
programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: No restriction by nationality or by residence. The benefit is open to EU and non-EU students alike. ER.GO treats as international, for the purposes of the economic assessment, students resident abroad and students resident in Italy who are not independent under current legislation and whose family members are resident abroad; Italian-law EEA and EU-equivalent residence categories are relevant to university admission, not to the scholarship. Holding the scholarship does not depend on any residence quota.
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Open worldwide. ER.GO operates a dedicated International Students section for applicants whose family unit has income and assets abroad, and states that the complete documentation, translated and legalised, must be issued by the authorities competent for that territory in the year in which the application is submitted, must show the previous year's income and the assets as at 31 December of the previous year, and must be re-submitted for every academic year applied for.
programme_detail_official.study_mode: Full-time on-campus study at a university or higher institute for art and music in Emilia-Romagna; at the University of Parma this covers first-cycle (laurea triennale) and single-cycle programmes, including degree courses and single course units taught in English, each with its own entry procedures for non-EU applicants.
programme_detail_official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No nominating agency or university nomination is required: the student applies directly to ER.GO. No field-of-study restriction is published for the borsa di studio, which is open across bachelor's, single-cycle and graduate programmes in the region; specific tables such as the S.T.E.M. course listings and the Parma merit-credit table are used for sub-allocations, not to exclude fields.
programme_detail_official.application_method: A separate application, submitted directly by the student on the ER.GO Dossier Utente through the benefits application form for the academic year, ticking the borsa di studio benefit; it is not automatic on admission and is independent of the university application. The application may be filed before enrolment and even before a university is chosen, but the student must then enrol in Emilia-Romagna by the enrolment deadlines of the call, and may transfer the application to another seat or course through the SCRIVI ticketing service. Foreign income documentation is uploaded separately in the Dossier Utente, and applications started at a CAF or with university credentials must be finalised with PEC or PIN by the same deadline.
programme_detail_official.application_route: Obtain the Italian tax code, read the published Bando di concorso, then complete the online benefits application on https://www.er-go.it/fai-domanda-online (Dossier Utente), tick borsa di studio (and accommodation if wanted) in the Benefici a concorso form, upload the foreign income and assets documentation under Corrispondenza e Protocollo > Invia documentazione > Documentazione redditi esteri, and finalise with PEC or PIN before 24 August 2026 16:00 for a.y. 2026/2027.

programme_detail_official.english_requirement_note: No English-language test or score is required by the ER.GO scholarship competition and none is published. The scholarship imposes only a documentary language rule: the foreign income and assets documentation must be issued in the original language, legalised or apostilled and translated into Italian, and the competition announcement and application are in Italian. Language requirements for entering a degree programme are set by the University of Parma and by the individual course, and the university maintains a list of degree courses and single course units taught in English with their own pre-evaluation procedures for non-EU students; those programme-level requirements are not conditions of this scholarship and are therefore not recorded here.
selection_criteria: Assignment by public competition (concorso pubblico) against the requirements of the published call.
Economic condition: the ISEE band of the family unit, with both the ISEE and the ISPE required to fall below the published thresholds.
Student status: in sede, pendolare or fuori sede, the last requiring documented domicile, which determines the amount.
Merit requirement: the minimum credits (CFU) for the academic year, from the tables published per seat of study, including a dedicated Parma table.
Enrolment requirement: enrolment finalised by the call's enrolment deadlines and the career active in the secretariat.
As a first-year entrant, the school-leaving grade is explicitly not taken into consideration.
No interview, portfolio, leadership or community-service criterion is published, and ER.GO states there are no merit-only scholarships among the benefits it pays out.
ER.GO carries out controls on the submitted documentation and revokes benefits in the case of untrue declarations, reporting them to the competent authorities.
programme_detail_official.duration: The benefit is granted one academic year at a time and must be re-requested every academic year, so a student entering a three-year bachelor's programme would apply three times, each time with documentation issued in that year. The minimum credits must be reached by 10 August of each academic year to confirm and keep the benefit.
award_holder_conditions: The scholarship is not an unconditional grant: ER.GO states 'La borsa di studio non e un finanziamento a fondo perduto' (the scholarship is not a subsidy to be kept automatically).
A minimum number of credits (CFU) must be reached by 10 August of each academic year, from the merit tables published for the seat of study.
If insufficient credits are acquired by 10 August, the benefits are revoked and what has been received must be repaid.
A new application must be submitted for every academic year, even without prior enrolment, with newly issued foreign income documentation for the year applied for.
Enrolment must be finalised by the enrolment deadlines of the call; failure to enrol within the terms causes loss of eligibility for the benefits.
The career must be active in the secretariat, otherwise the position in the ranking list is suspended until the secretariat confirms it.
The domicile must be correctly documented to obtain the fuori sede status that determines the amount.
Untrue declarations lead to revocation of the benefits and a report to the competent authorities.

Changes of course, seat or university must be communicated to ER.GO through the SCRIVI ticketing service, which can also transfer the application; ER.GO warns that withdrawal, transfer or change of course can negatively affect the ability to keep benefits and the stay permit.
The student must not use agencies or intermediaries, which ER.GO warns charge for the service and can cause errors.

programme_detail_official.description: The borsa di studio is the Emilia-Romagna regional right-to-study benefit, assigned by public competition to students enrolled at universities and higher arts and music institutes with their seat in Emilia-Romagna, including the University of Parma. It is open to applicants of any nationality and to students whose household income and assets are held abroad, and it covers first-cycle, single-cycle and graduate programmes. Eligible students receive a cash sum diversified by ISEE band and student status, total exemption from university tuition fees and a refund of the regional tax, and may convert part of the scholarship into catering vouchers.
programme_detail_official.program_type: Regional right-to-study scholarship (means-tested) with a linked tuition-fee exemption
programme_detail_official.coverage: A cash borsa di studio for one academic year with the amount set annually by the competition announcement and diversified by the family's ISEE band and by student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede); total exemption from university tuition fees; refund of the regional tax paid as the first enrolment instalment; optional conversion of part of the scholarship into catering vouchers; and, in the same application, competitive access to ER.GO accommodation. Uncovered: living costs beyond the scholarship amount, which is not published; travel; and visa costs.

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your family's ISEE and ISPE will both fall under EUR 25,000 / EUR 50,000 before you invest time, because exceeding either bars the application entirely.
Get an Italian tax code (codice fiscale) first; you cannot file the benefits application without it.
Read the current Bando di concorso in full, especially the Soglie economiche, the Scadenze table and the Parma merit-credit table.

Start the foreign income and assets documentation immediately when the call opens in June: it must be issued by the competent authority in the year of application and then legalised or apostilled and translated into Italian, which is the step that usually takes longest.
Check whether your country is party to the Apostille Convention, and if not, start consular legalisation early instead.
Start the equivalence route for your secondary school qualification: CIMEA certificate of comparability, ARDI certificate of equivalence, or a Declaration of Value from the Italian embassy.
Plan to finalise enrolment at the University of Parma by the call's enrolment deadlines, because an inactive career suspends your ranking position.
Prepare the domicile documentation or autocertificazione di domicilio if you want the higher fuori sede amount.
Decide whether to tick accommodation in the same application, and note that it has a different deadline from the scholarship.
File the application in June or July, not in August, so that a documentation problem can still be fixed before the absolute deadline.
Do not pay an intermediary; ER.GO explicitly warns that they charge and can cause errors.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the absolute deadline of 24 August 2026 at 16:00 Italian time; ER.GO states the deadlines are tassative e improrogabili (mandatory and not extendable).
Exceeding either economic threshold: ISEE above EUR 25,000 or ISPE above EUR 50,000.
Foreign income documentation issued in the wrong year: it must be issued in the year the application is submitted, and re-issued every year you apply.
Income documentation issued by an authority that is not the competent one for the territory.
Missing legalisation or apostille, or a missing Italian translation of the income documents.
Leaving the foreign income documentation unuploaded in the Dossier Utente under Documentazione redditi esteri.
Starting the application at a CAF or with university credentials and forgetting to finalise it with PEC or PIN by the same deadline.
Not finalising enrolment, which causes loss of eligibility and suspends the ranking position.
Assuming eligibility in the provisional ranking means the scholarship has been awarded; assignment is only communicated after the pre-definitive ranking.

Applying for accommodation with the wrong deadline in mind; accommodation for first-year and single-cycle first-years ran to 24 August 2026 at 16:00 but other categories ran to 6 August 2026 at 16:00.
Losing the fuori sede band because the domicile was not documented; the autocertificazione di domicilio deadline was 3 November 2026 at 16:00 and the full documentation 14 January 2027.
Paying an intermediary who then files incorrect documents, which ER.GO verifies and can treat as untrue declarations.
estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs beyond the scholarship amount, which ER.GO does not publish on the pages consulted, so the gap cannot be calculated in advance.
Travel to and from Italy: no travel allowance is part of the borsa di studio, and ER.GO's international mobility contribution is a separate benefit with its own deadline.
Visa costs and the stay-permit application: no visa support is provided, only the possibility of filing the benefits application before enrolment while awaiting the acceptance letter.
The first instalment of EUR 156.00 (regional tax and stamp duty) must be paid up front at enrolment and is only refunded once the scholarship is awarded.
Tuition if the scholarship is not awarded: for students with income abroad the annual personalised contribution ranges from EUR 0 to about EUR 2,000, plus the EUR 156.00 first instalment.
Accommodation if no ER.GO place is assigned: the university's Vetrina alloggi and private market apply, with no subsidy guaranteed.
Food beyond any catering vouchers converted from the scholarship.
Italian translations, apostilles or consular legalisation fees, which are borne by the applicant and are not reimbursed.
document_audit: The income documentation must be issued in the year you apply, showing the previous year's income and the assets as at 31 December of the previous year; old certificates are not accepted even if nothing changed.
The signature of the public official who drafted the documentation must be legalised or apostilled, unless your country has a convention removing that requirement.
Every document not already in Italian must be translated into Italian; translations into English are not sufficient for the ER.GO file, unlike for some academic documents.
The foreign income documentation goes into the Dossier Utente, not into the academic file: Corrispondenza e Protocollo > Invia documentazione > Documentazione redditi esteri.

The secondary school qualification needs a CIMEA certificate of comparability, an ARDI certificate of equivalence, or a Declaration of Value; the Italian translations and the authenticity documentation are separate from the equivalence certificate.

If your country's school system is shorter than 12 years, the transcript of the first-year exams, the Foundation Year certificate or the post-secondary qualification is what completes the file, and the Italian translations must cover those too.
The domicile documentation is a separate submission from the income documentation and has its own later deadlines.
The medical or health documents, passport and residence permit belong to the university enrolment file at the Welcome Point, not to the ER.GO benefits application.
Because you must re-apply every year, build a habit of requesting the income and assets documentation in the same month each year rather than starting from scratch.

alerts.trigger: You are relying on the 2026/2027 cycle
alerts.message: The scholarship deadline of 24 August 2026 at 16:00 has passed and ER.GO labels the benefit as expired. Wait for the next call, expected from around mid-June 2027, and check the deadlines page before preparing documents; the 2027/2028 dates are not yet published.

alerts.trigger: Your family income is held abroad
alerts.message: Your economic situation must be converted into the Italian ISEE system, so you need legalised, Italian-translated income and assets documents issued in the year of application. Start this the week the call opens, because it is the step that most often fails.

alerts.trigger: You have not yet enrolled or chosen a course
alerts.message: You can still apply: ER.GO explicitly allows applying before enrolment and even before choosing a course, and you can transfer the application to another Emilia-Romagna seat or course through the SCRIVI service. But your ranking position is suspended until your career is active in the secretariat, and failure to enrol by the call's deadlines loses eligibility.

alerts.trigger: You want the highest benefit amount
alerts.message: The amount depends on being classified as fuori sede, which requires a documented domicile. File the autocertificazione di domicilio by 3 November 2026 at 16:00, or the full domicile documentation by 14 January 2027, for the a.y. 2026/2027 cycle.

alerts.trigger: You expect the scholarship to be automatic once you are admitted
alerts.message: It is not. The borsa di studio requires its own application every academic year with its own deadline, and it is a competition with ranking lists, so being admitted to the University of Parma does not secure it.

alerts.trigger: You are counting on a fixed published amount
alerts.message: No euro figure is published on the official pages consulted. ER.GO sets the amounts in the annual competition announcement and differentiates them by ISEE band and by student status, so read the Bando and the 'Importi, pagamenti e revoche' tables for the year you are applying before budgeting.

alerts.trigger: You are applying for accommodation too
alerts.message: Accommodation is requested in the same application form by ticking the item under Benefici a concorso, but it has a different deadline: 6 August 2026 at 16:00 for continuing students, second-cycle confirming students, specialisation and doctorate students, and 24 August 2026 at 16:00 for first-cycle and single-cycle first-years and for new second-cycle applicants.

alerts.trigger: Your credits are below the required minimum
alerts.message: The scholarship is not an unconditional grant. If you do not reach the minimum credits by 10 August, the benefit is revoked and what you received must be repaid. Check the Parma merit-credit table in the current call before you plan your exam sessions.

submission_workflow: Read the Bando di concorso benefici DSU for the academic year, together with the Soglie economiche and Scadenze pages and the Parma merit-credit table.
Obtain the Italian tax code (codice fiscale).
Request the household income and assets documentation from the competent authority abroad, for the previous year's income and the assets as at 31 December of the previous year.
Have the documentation legalised or apostilled and translated into Italian.
Open the Dossier Utente and complete the benefits application form, ticking borsa di studio and, if wanted, alloggio under Benefici a concorso.
Upload the foreign income documentation under Corrispondenza e Protocollo > Invia documentazione > Documentazione redditi esteri.
If you started the application at a CAF or with university credentials, finalise it with PEC or PIN by the same deadline.
Finalise your enrolment at the University of Parma online and submit the academic documents to the Welcome Point so that the career becomes active.
Watch the Dossier Utente and the Graduatorie page for the provisional, pre-definitive and definitive ranking lists.
Keep checking the minimum credits against the Parma merit table and reach them by 10 August to keep the benefit.
If you change seat, course or plan to withdraw, notify ER.GO through the SCRIVI service before acting, because it can affect both the benefit and your stay permit.

official_fields_confirmed: Official award name: borsa di studio, awarded by public competition (concorso pubblico)
Awarding body: ER.GO - Azienda Regionale per il Diritto agli Studi Superiori dell'Emilia-Romagna, with the University of Parma jointly administering the benefits

Deadline for a.y. 2026/2027: applications open 23 June 2026, closing 24 August 2026 at 16:00 Italian time, with the same date and time for the total tuition exemption linked to a scholarship application
The deadlines are described as mandatory and not extendable (tassative e improrogabili)
Eligibility requirements: economic, merit and enrolment, all three cumulative
Economic thresholds for a.y. 2026/2027: ISEE up to EUR 25,000.00 and ISPE up to EUR 50,000.00, both required to be under the thresholds

Documentation rules for students with income and assets abroad: issued by the competent authority in the year of application, showing the previous year's income and the assets as at 31 December, legalised or apostilled, translated into Italian, uploaded in the Dossier Utente under Documentazione redditi esteri, and re-submitted every year
Merit condition: minimum credits (CFU) by 10 August of each academic year, with the scholarship explicitly described as not an unconditional grant, and revocation with repayment if not reached
As a first-year entrant the school-leaving grade is not taken into consideration and the applicant is assessed solely on the economic requirement
The application may be filed before enrolment, and even before choosing a course or region
Benefits attached: total university tuition-fee exemption and refund of the regional tax, plus optional conversion into catering vouchers
Amounts are diversified by the family unit's ISEE band and by student status (in sede, pendolare, fuori sede), with domicile required for the fuori sede status
No merit-only scholarships exist among the benefits ER.GO pays out
University of Parma tuition structure for students with income abroad: first instalment EUR 156.00 and annual personalised tuition from EUR 0 to about EUR 2,000

University of Parma entry requirements for a foreign secondary school qualification: 12 years of schooling, CIMEA comparability, ARDI equivalence or Declaration of Value, transcripts or Foundation Year for shorter systems, Italian translations, and authenticity verification
University of Parma personalised university contribution deadline for a.y. 2026/2027: 4 November 2026 at 17:00
Accommodation is a separate benefit in the same application with different deadlines (6 August 2026 and 24 August 2026 at 16:00)

logo_override.alt_text: ER.GO - Azienda Regionale per il Diritto agli Studi Superiori dell'Emilia-Romagna
logo_override.validation_detail: Probed live 2026-10-03: HTTP 200 OK, Content-Type image/png, 4954 bytes, so the URL serves image bytes and not an HTML or WAF interstitial. The PNG is 277x182 and fully opaque (0 transparent pixels); a pixel audit found 3479 saturated red pixels and 759 dark pixels against a white ground, so it is a red-and-dark mark on white and not a white-on-transparent wordmark, which the rules exclude. The asset is referenced as src="/logo-ergo-1.png/@@images/image" in the body markup of the ER.GO homepage beneath the heading 'ER.GO - Azienda regionale per il Diritto agli Studi Superiori dell'Emilia Romagna', so it is the agency's own mark. The favicon at https://www.er-go.it/favicon.ico also returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type image/x-icon at 15406 bytes as a fallback, but the larger logo was preferred. The Regione Emilia-Romagna logo on the same site was deliberately not used, because it belongs to the region rather than to the awarding agency.

research_notes.logo: The logo is served by the awarding body's own domain: https://www.er-go.it/logo-ergo-1.png/@@images/image, probed live on 2026-10-03 with HTTP 200 and Content-Type image/png at 4954 bytes, so it returns image bytes rather than an HTML interstitial. It is referenced in the ER.GO homepage markup under the heading naming the agency, so it is ER.GO's own mark and not a host university or third-party logo. The PNG was downloaded and audited pixel by pixel: 277x182, zero transparent pixels, 3479 saturated red pixels and 759 dark pixels on a white ground, so it is a red-and-dark mark on white and is not a white-on-transparent wordmark of the kind the rules exclude. The University of Parma mark at https://www.unipr.it/themes/custom/unipr_2025/logo.svg was located and read but deliberately rejected on two grounds: every fill in that SVG is #fff, i.e. a pure white-on-transparent wordmark that the rules exclude, and the University of Parma is the joint administrator and host institution rather than the awarding body, so using its mark would be a provenance error. The Regione Emilia-Romagna logo on the ER.GO site was also rejected because it belongs to the region rather than to ER.GO. The favicon /favicon.ico (HTTP 200, image/x-icon, 15406 bytes) was probed as a fallback. The host er-go.it was not present in backend/config/official_logo_overrides.json, so no deduplication is expected.

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: Two official sources confirm the award funds entry into a bachelor's degree. First, the University of Parma's enrolment page for EU students and students with foreign degrees states under 'Inscription in a Three-Year Program or a Single-Cycle Program (First-Cycle Program)': 'You can enroll in a Bachelor's degree course or a single-cycle degree course if you hold a foreign high school diploma that is recognized as eligible under Italian law', and the qualification must 'have been obtained upon completion of a schooling period of at least 12 years'. Second, ER.GO's own deadlines page for a.y. 2026/2027 shows the same 23/06/2026 to 24/08/2026 16:00 window applying to first-cycle entrants: the accommodation line is headed 'Alloggio per: matricole dei corsi di primo ciclo e ciclo unico' with that exact deadline, and the scholarship itself carries the same dates with no cycle restriction. ER.GO's 'Studente Matricola' page confirms first-year entrants are eligible: 'Non ho ancora perfezionato l'iscrizione all'istituto accademico. Posso presentare domanda di benefici? Si, puoi fare domanda anche senza essere ancora iscritto' and, on grades, 'Ai fini dei benefici ER.GO il voto di diploma non e tenuto in considerazione. In quanto matricola verrai valutato solamente sulla base del tuo requisito economico'. The University of Parma's international fees page confirms the same benefit set is available to international students: 'You can fill in the application even if you are not yet enrolled at the university (if you are a student applying for a visa, wait until you have obtained your acceptance letter)'. The award also covers second-cycle and single-cycle programmes, so degree_levels is set to "Bachelor's" for this record and the wider coverage is recorded in the funding_duration, duration and benefits fields.
